specCorrection.reason: The former unconditional held-LMB retargeting statement lacked the orchestrator decision: while an attack key remains held, pointer movement only aims; fresh ground clicks still retarget. A fresh attack press still cancels movement.

respawnFixture.reason: The accident checkpoint respawns next to the bat and triggers the intentional garage rack-grab input lock. The old movement assertion ran during that beat, toward a solid prop only 0.57 m away. The fixture now waits for the beat to finish, retains prop classification assertions, and measures the unchanged >0.5 m travel threshold toward unobstructed ground. No gameplay respawn behavior was changed.

remoteUnitAndLevels.command: sh tools/remote/run.sh "$PWD" -- npx vitest run tests/unit tests/levels --maxWorkers=4

epicE03.command: E2E_PORT=4381 SCENE_PORT=4382 E2E_UNITS=1 sh tools/e2e-lock.sh npm run verify -- E03

attemptNotes: The remote E03 browser attempt failed the arrival cadence assertion (2 frames in three seconds; required >30); the gate was retained and verified on the native GPU.
One local E03 attempt was interrupted after an overlapping queued command cleared its trace directory. The final full E03 run was serialized and passed all 171 browser tests.
